name: MissingPropertyHandler
signature: public delegate void MissingPropertyHandler(ShaderProgram program, PropertyID name, ResourceKind expectedKind, uint set, int bindingIndex)

docs.summary: Fires when a reflected resource slot has no entry in the merged property table; a default gets substituted.

params.program: Graphics or compute program being bound.
params.name: Name of the missing resource.
params.bindingIndex: Binding / register index in the set.
